edit.description: populate it from the records it already builds for the verdict

summary: Report the wave's per-entry gate-failure records on `TickResult`, so a handoff reads the failed gate and its signature instead of inferring them from `gateResults`

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: a `handoff` reads each entry's failed gate, message and signature off `TickResult`; every existing field stays byte-identical.
tests: a fanout wave's TickResult reports each entry's gate failure with the signature the tick verdict recorded
notes: The verdict already holds `GateFailure[]` keyed by `gateFailureSignature` (`src/tickVerdict.ts`); `TickResult` carries only untagged `gateResults` rows, so counting how many of a wave's entries failed one gate on one message is an inference today. A fact, never a verdict: what a repeated signature means stays the chain's. The enumeration in spec/chain.md is the human's to extend.

edit.description: widen the section-arm case's title; give its fixture a blockquote lead to resolve against

summary: Widen the section-arm case's title to the page's settled enumeration, and give its fixture the blockquote lead the widened title claims

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: the title names headings, bolded bullet leads and a bolded lead opening a blockquote line, and the fixture cites a section each of those three arms mints.
notes: Today the title stops at "the page's headings and bolded bullet leads", the page's pre-ruling wording. The fixture carries no blockquote lead, so widening the title alone would claim a subject the body never exercises (*A green verdict is proven non-vacuous*). No `tests[]` line: the whole diff is the file carrying the case.
